hits.title: TELA Bio Announces Changes to its Board of Directors
hits.snippet: [hires | 2021-06-02] TELA Bio, Inc. hired John Nosenzo as board of directors on Jun 2nd '21. TELA Bio, Inc. ("TELA"), a commercial-stage medical technology company focused on designing, developing, and marketing innovative tissue reinforcement materials to address unmet needs in soft tissue reconstruction, today announced that it has appointed John Nosenzo, the Chief Commercial Officer of Bioventus Inc., to its board of directors effective June 2, 2021.
